sloka: यदर्थं सागरः क्रान्तः सेतुर्बद्धश्च सागरे ।सो ऽयमद्य रणे पापश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः ।। ६.१०१.५३ ।।
transliteration: yadarthaṁ sāgaraḥ krāntaḥ seturbaddhaśca sāgare ।so 'yamadya raṇe pāpaścakṣurviṣayamāgataḥ ।। 6.101.53 ।।

translations.english: 'Seat yourselves at ease upon the mountain-tops, O invincible bulls among monkeys, and behold this battle — this fight is mine and Ravana's.'
